```text
Model:

Why should this model be included?
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Verified the official project/repository
- [ ] Verified the exact model name and version
- [ ] Verified the license (linked to the actual license source)
- [ ] Verified the intended task/category and subcategory
- [ ] Verified parameters and model size, if applicable (or marked `N/A`)
- [ ] Verified hardware requirements, if available (no invented VRAM numbers)
- [ ] Added to the correct file(s) in `data/models/`
- [ ] No duplicate entry already exists for this model/variant
- [ ] Formatting matches the existing table structure in the target file
